name: Observatoire de Haute-Provence
description: A French national observatory established in 1937 near Saint-Michel-l'Observatoire, at about 650 m. It operates 1.93 m, 1.52 m, 1.20 m and 0.80 m reflecting telescopes.
highlights: In 1995 Michel Mayor and Didier Queloz found the planet orbiting 51 Pegasi, the first around a Sun-like star, with the ELODIE spectrograph on the 1.93 m telescope.
That discovery earned them half of the 2019 Nobel Prize in Physics.
Observations began in 1943 with the 1.20 m telescope.
